01

“And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:5).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs [Ibrahim 5] meaning: "with the clear proofs." Warqa said, and Ibn Jurayj said: "The nine signs are the clear proofs."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَى بِآيَاتِنَا [إبراهيم: 5] ، يَعْنِي: «بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ» . قَالَ وَرْقَاءُ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ: «الْآيَاتُ التِّسْعُ هِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ»
Edition record 372470 · p. 410Link to report ↗
02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and remind them of the days of God [Ibrahim 5] he said: "of the favors of God, Mighty and Majestic."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ [إبراهيم: 5] قَالَ: «بِنِعَمِ اللَّهِ عز وجل»
Edition record 372471 · p. 410Link to report ↗
02

“so they put their hands to their mouths”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:9).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid,
so they put their hands to their mouths [Ibrahim 9] He says: "they rejected their words to them and called them liars."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
فَرَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ [إبراهيم: 9] يَقُولُ: «رَدُّوا عَلَيْهِمْ قَوْلَهُمْ وَكَذَّبُوهُمْ»

03

“and they sought victory”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:15).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid,
and they sought victory [Ibrahim 15] meaning: "all the messengers"; He says: they asked for help against their people. God says: and disappointed was every obstinate tyrant [Ibrahim 15] meaning: "one who stubbornly opposes the truth and keeps away from it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَاسْتَفْتَحُوا [إبراهيم: 15] ، يَعْنِي: «الرُّسُلَ كُلَّهُمْ» ، يَقُولُ: اسْتَنْصَرُوا عَلَى قَوْمِهِمْ، يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: وَخَابَ كُلُّ جُبَارٍ عَنِيدٍ [إبراهيم: 15] ، يَعْنِي: «مُعَانِدٌ لِلْحَقِّ مُجَانِبُهُ»
Edition record 372473 · p. 410Link to report ↗

05

“I cannot help you”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:22).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
I cannot help you [Ibrahim 22] that is: "come to your aid"; nor can you help me [Ibrahim 22] that is: "come to my aid."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مَا أَنَا بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ [إبراهيم: 22] أَيْ: «بِمُغِيثِكُمْ» وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِيِّ [إبراهيم: 22] أَيْ: «بِمُغِيثِيِّ»
Edition record 372475 · p. 411Link to report ↗
06

“Have you not considered how God presents an example: a good word…”

An explanation transmitted from Anas ibn Mālik (Q 14:24, 14:26).

07
Explanation from Anas ibn Mālik 07

Anas ibn Mālik

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Shuayb ibn al-Habhab, from Anas ibn Malik, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ recited this verse: Have you not considered how God presents an example: a good word like a good tree, whose root is firm [Ibrahim 24]. He said: "It is the date palm." And he recited: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree [Ibrahim 26], and he said: "The colocynth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: تَلَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ [إبراهيم: 24] قَالَ: «هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ» . وَتَلَا وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ [إبراهيم: 26] فَقَالَ: «الْحَنْظَلَةُ»
Edition record 372476 · p. 411Link to report ↗
07

“It produces its fruit all the time by permission of its Lord”

Two explanations transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:25).

08
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 08

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words:
It produces its fruit all the time by permission of its Lord [Ibrahim 25] he said: "meaning every six months."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا [إبراهيم: 25] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي كُلَّ سِتَّةِ أَشْهُرٍ»
Edition record 372477 · p. 411Link to report ↗

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English

all the time [Ibrahim 25] meaning: "every year."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:

08

“God keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in worldly life…”

An explanation transmitted from Abū Hurayra.

10
Explanation from Abū Hurayra 10

Abū Hurayra

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salama, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ recited: God keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in worldly life and in the Hereafter [Ibrahim 27], and he said: "That is when he is asked in the grave: 'Who is your Lord? What is your religion? Who is your prophet?' And he says: 'God is my Lord, Islam is my religion, and my prophet is Muhammad; he came to us with clear proofs from God, so I believed in him and affirmed him.' It is said: 'You have spoken truly; on this you lived, on this you died, and on this you will be resurrected.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: تَلَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ
يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ [سورة: إبراهيم، آية رقم: 27] فَقَالَ: " ذَاكَ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ فِي الْقَبْرِ: مَنْ رَبُّكَ؟ وَمَا دِينُكَ؟ وَمَنْ نَبِيُّكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: اللَّهُ رَبِّي، وَالْإِسْلَامُ دِينِي، وَنَبِيِّي مُحَمَّدٌ، جَاءَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ فَآمَنْتُ بِهِ وَصَدَّقْتُ، فَيُقَالُ: صَدَقْتَ، عَلَى هَذَا عِشْتَ، وَعَلَيْهِ مِتَّ، وَعَلَيْهِ تُبْعَثُ "
Edition record 372479 · p. 411Link to report ↗
09

“those who exchanged the favor of God for disbelief”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn Abī Najīḥ (Q 14:28).

11
Explanation from Ibn Abī Najīḥ 11

Ibn Abī Najīḥ

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, on His words:
those who exchanged the favor of God for disbelief [Ibrahim 28]: "The favor of God is Muhammad and faith; they exchanged it for disbelief; they are the disbelievers of Quraysh at Badr."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيْحٍ: فِي قَوْلِهِ:
بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا [إبراهيم: 28] " وَنِعْمَةُ اللَّهِ: مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْإِيمَانُ، بَدَّلُوهُ كُفْرًا، وَهُمْ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ بِبَدْرٍ "

12

“make hearts among the people incline toward them”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 14:37).

14
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 14

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu al-Rabi al-Samman related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
"If Abraham, the Friend of the Merciful, had said: 'Make the hearts of people incline toward them,' the Jews and the Christians would have made the pilgrimage to it. But he said: make hearts among the people incline toward them [Ibrahim 37], so he specified the believers by it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ السَّمَّانُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
" لَوْ أَنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلَ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ: فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ، لَحَجَّهُ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى، وَلَكِنَّهُ قَالَ: فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ [إبراهيم: 37] ، فَخَصَّ بِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ "
Edition record 372483 · p. 412Link to report ↗

14

“there would be for you no decline”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:44).

18
Explanation from Mujāhid 18

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
there would be for you no decline [Ibrahim 44] meaning: "that you would not die," addressing Quraysh.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ زَوَالٍ [إبراهيم: 44] ، يَعْنِي: «لَا تَمُوتُونَ لِقُرَيْشٍ»

15

“on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:48).

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth [Ibrahim 48] he said: "It will be replaced by a white earth as if it were silver, and the heavens likewise as if they were silver."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ [إبراهيم: 48] قَالَ: «تُبَدَّلُ أَرْضًا بَيْضَاءَ كَأَنَّهَا الْفِضَّةُ، وَالسَّمَوَاتُ كَذَلِكَ كَأَنَّهَا الْفِضَّةُ»
